name: whats-erase
description: Agendador pessoal de exclusao de mensagens enviadas via Evolution API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @whats-erase/server" "npm run dev -w @whats-erase/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @whats-erase/web && npm run build -w @whats-erase/server
scripts.check: npm run lint:md && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
